1100.author: lh913137941
1100.body:
## What

DM31-M39 preparation slice for #829: extract the notification read/dismiss version owner and the push subscription owner out of the legacy bridge into `plugins/notifications/`, behind the host ports the DM31-A32 gateway will bind later.

- `plugins/notifications/state.py` — `NotificationState` mark record (legacy payload shape: sha256(principal) id, reads, dismissals, revision), exact-version validators, alias fan-out, history caps, and `NotificationService` (the owning public proxy for `notification.read` / `notification.dismiss`). Selectively adapted from `engine_notifications.py::NotificationState; register` at frozen main `1b67babf`.
- `plugins/notifications/push.py` — `PushNotifier` + `PushSubscriptionService` (the owning public proxy for `push.key` / `push.subscribe` / `push.unsubscribe`), RFC 8291 aes128gcm + RFC 8292 VAPID (12h ES256), endpoint/SSRF scope checks, quiet hours, priming and one-projection-per-notice semantics. Selectively adapted from `engine_push.py` at `1b67babf`.
- `tests/server/plugin_gateway/st/test_m39_boundary.py` — boundary ST (26 tests) over real participants: the two owner modules, a real SQLite mark store, real `push.json` persistence, real RFC 8291/8292 cryptography with an independently written browser-side decrypt check.
- `docs/plans/v31-server-migration/module-ownership.json` — registers the `plugins` root and the `notifications` component (`status: extracting`, `checked: true`, public `notifications.state` / `notifications.push`).
- `.github/ci-gates.json` — server-contracts markers + `minimumTests` 12 → 38.

## Owner boundaries kept

- The owner never sees a legacy EngineService/Bridge: DM record truth stays with Agent Service/Store, queried through the read-only `NotificationSources` port (`standing_records()` is prebuilt once per action, mirroring the legacy closure); the unread-clearing effect goes through `NotificationAcknowledgements.acknowledge` inside the mark-store transaction.
- Scoped vs unscoped asymmetry preserved: mark-time reads are room-scoped (foreign → PermissionError, archived → "This space was removed"); standing checks use unscoped `find_*`, so clearing an alert never depends on current room membership.
- `redact` stays single-owned by the memory domain: injected as a required `redact` callable; the ST uses a controlled named redactor and asserts a password in the person's ask stays off the lock screen.
- No DM session/run records, model/tool calls, or extension wiring in the owner: action binding (`service.extensions`), snapshot-view registration and the store-listener flush loop belong to DM31-A32 / Host lifecycle.
- Legacy `engine_notifications.py` / `engine_push.py` are untouched (read-only sources until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate changes).

## Explicit non-goals (this PR does not switch production)

Blocked-by per the issue — #762 (DM31-M01) and #758 (DM31-A32) — remains true: the legacy bridge keeps serving `notification.*` and `push.*` in production. This PR lands the owning public proxies, their boundary ST and the policy registration; the integration/cutover slice lands with DM31-A32, and the legacy-inventory retirement gate for `engine_notifications` / `engine_push` fires only after that. No production switch is claimed.

## Test evidence

```
python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.plugin_gateway.st.test_m39_boundary
# Ran 26 tests ... OK

python3 -B tools/architecture/manifest.py --check docs/plans/v31-server-migration/module-ownership.json
# 61 owners, 0 exceptions

python3 -B tools/architecture/check.py --policy docs/plans/v31-server-migration/module-ownership.json --root . --format json
# findings: []  (290 files)

python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/architecture -p "test_import_gate.py"
# Ran 6 tests ... OK
```

Coverage of the issue's required cases: normal (read/dismiss exact version + restart persistence, scoped subscribe/unsubscribe roundtrip), failure (stale version, missing source, foreign record → PermissionError with no partial writes, expired/gone subscription pruned, malformed keys/endpoints rejected), concurrency (dismiss v1 never marks newly created v2 read; duplicate provider callback projects once; revision race raises "changed underneath" and preserves the racing writer's mark), and cross-account isolation (no cross-account push with zero subscriptions; principal-scoped mark stores).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

## Problem

The dashboard's historical request timing starts at gateway dispatch, after dequeue and preparation, and a text-typed empty chunk can consume the first-text logging budget. The product WorkSwarm adapter has no producer for the tool-call JSONL records consumed by the dashboard, so tool durations and observed pairing coverage are unavailable.

## Changes

- Record a content-free marker when the WebSocket gateway parses a valid DigitalMate `chat.send`, before file preparation. Keep the historical dispatch marker and #1076 trajectory stages unchanged.
- Preserve the bounded head/first-text logging budget while ignoring empty text chunks for first-text selection.
- Record content-free tool starts and results in the workspace, pair only unique call IDs within a stream, measure elapsed time with a monotonic clock, and distinguish known errors, known success and unknown outcomes. Missing, duplicate and unmatched IDs are not timed by name; telemetry errors do not break the stream.
- Document boundaries, privacy, coverage limits and deployment obligations in `docs/developer_guide/cloud-metrics-974.md`.

Related: #974, #975, #1076. This does not close #974: the actual deployed producer and consumer, cross-environment coverage, and simulator correlation still require verification. Companion dashboard collector PR will consume the new records separately from the legacy dispatch baseline.

An isolated terminal execution attempt was rejected with HTTP 418; candidate deployment, real provider/tool execution, simulator, and production data are not verified. 1111.author: lh913137941
1111.body:
## 背景

production-metrics 板上的 `uplink_send`、`downlink_first_text`、`downlink_terminal` 三张卡片一直显示“不可用：缺少可验证的帧配对和时钟误差”。原因是单向时间任何一端都测不出来：

```text
手机点发送 ──上行──▶ 桥收到请求 ──排队/模型/工具──▶ 桥推首帧 ──下行──▶ 手机收到首帧
```

桥不知道手机何时按下发送、何时真正收到；手机不知道桥何时收到、何时推出；而且两台机器的墙钟不同，直接相减会把时钟偏移算进网络耗时。

本 PR 让两端各自记录自己那一半，并用一次往返把两半拼起来：#972 的帧配对 + #973 的时钟误差上界。设计说明见 `docs/design/client-network-metrics.md`。

## 改动

**桥（`server_engine/server.py`）**
- 每条 `digitalmate.task.text` 帧新增 `at`（桥墙钟 epoch ms，推帧时刻），既有字段不变；
- `digitalmate.request` 成功响应新增 `result.timing = {received_at_ms, sent_at_ms}`，即时钟样本的 T1/T2；
- 新增 `client_timing` 入参，在动作校验**之前**弹出（`EngineRequest` 为 `extra="forbid"`，它是传输元数据而非 engine 字段）。

**记录器（新 `server_engine/client_network.py`）**
- 写 `<workspace>/workswarm/client-network-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl`，schema `digitalmate-client-network@1`，`bucket` 与卡片同名；
- 验收规则：`error_ms ≤ 50`、`|offset| ≤ 24h`、`server_at_ms` 与已推帧 `at` 精确相等、`execution_id` 一致、`0 ≤ 单向 ≤ 120000`；不满足的不猜，按原因计数；
- 容量与安全：队列 1024（满则计 `dropped`，不阻塞回合）、每 task 保留最近 96 帧 + 首条文本帧、512 task LRU、4096 去重 LRU、0600 + `O_NOFOLLOW` + 常规文件校验、daemon 写线程；
- 每 120 秒及关闭时写 `coverage`，让“卡片为空”可区分为未开启 / 无流量 / 配对不上 / 时钟不达标。

**手机（`cloud-adapter`）**
- 新增纯逻辑模块 `DigitalMateNetworkTiming.ets`：NTP 公式
  `offset = ((T0−T1)+(T3−T2))/2`、`error = ((T3−T0)−(T2−T1))/2`，保留误差最小的样本，5 分钟后允许更新；
- `DigitalMateClient` 在**收到过 `timing` 之后**才发送 `client_timing`——旧桥会拒绝未知参数，这样灰度期不会让请求失败；
- 只缓存每个 task 的首条有文本帧与终帧，最多 32 个 task，每次请求后清空；不保存任何回复文本。

## 兼容性

- 旧客户端忽略 `at` / `timing`；
- 旧桥不会返回 `timing`，新客户端因此一直不带 `client_timing`，行为与之前完全一致；
- 默认开关 `DIGITALMATE_NETWORK_METRICS_ENABLED=false`：关闭时无目录、无线程、无文件写入。

## 验证

- `pytest tests/test_client_network.py tests/test_push_delivery.py tests/test_digitalmate_protocol.py`：23 passed, 1 skipped（POSIX 符号链接用例在 Windows 跳过）；
- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-network-timing.test.mjs`：6 pass / 0 fail；
- `tests/unit/digitalmate-profiling.test.mjs` 通过；`digitalmate-session-proximity.test.mjs` 的两个用例在本机因 CRLF 检出导致源码切片越界而报 ArkUI 语法错误，该文件未被本 PR 修改，属本地检出问题；
- 未做真机联调：验收范围为单测 + 设计文档。

## 后续

- 仪表盘仓库需一个独立 PR 增加采集脚本读取 `client-network-*.jsonl` 汇入三张卡片；在那之前文件已落盘，可回溯；
- 工具耗时由 #1101 / dashboard #42 负责，与本 PR 无重叠。

1112.body:
## Problem and fix

After a legacy Home conversation is grouped into a historical topic, quoting an old answer can fail with `BAD_PARAMS: The quoted message belongs to another conversation`. The admission hook compares the new topic thread against the original pre-upgrade thread even when both belong to the same published historical archive. Accept that case using the history owner's existing scoped assignment check, while retaining the existing room, message and cross-conversation checks.

A paginated old answer can also be visible without its task in the current client snapshot. Send its exact message reference to the server for validation instead of rejecting it locally; task-only references still require a loaded task.

## Routing and verification

- Base: `38bfe1a61f0d28a31c3851806b155c86d80d8a97`. The supported production entry is EngineService with session proximity and the registered engine turns hooks; the existing history archive owns assignment and the existing admission writer remains the sole writer. No new contract, store format, migration adapter, or writer is introduced. Carry forward with session migration tracking in #737.
- Regression: actual EngineService and temporary persistence with registered production reply hooks and a controlled executor. The new migrated-history case fails on the base with the observed `BAD_PARAMS` and passes with this change, both with a parent task and with only the native message reference. Existing cross-room/reset rejection remains covered.
- `python -m unittest test_session_proximity_integration test_engine_turns`: 83 passed before the additional message-only assertion; the extended regression and cross-room/reset case passed afterward. Python 3.13 from local Miniforge, repository vendored mandate wheel, Telethon 1.45.0 in a temporary dependency directory, other dependencies from local environment.
- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-message-actions.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-adapter.test.mjs tests/unit/digitalmate-parallel-topics.test.mjs`: 120 passed on Node 24.13.1. These run the actual client sources in the repository test harness.
- Not run: HarmonyOS build or device/emulator validation, full CI, candidate image build or post-fix test-0 deployment. The live failure was observed on the earlier v0.1.10 image; these local tests do not establish device or deployed-image parity. Independent review and applicable CI remain required before merge.
1112.head: codex/fix-migrated-history-quotes
1112.title: fix(session): allow replies to migrated history

1114.author: Jianyu010
1114.body:
The Store writer scan classifies any nonliteral `execute` call as dynamic SQL. That flags the A32 Gateway's reviewed `ToolProvider.execute(ToolCall, Mapping)` dispatch during trusted consumer validation.

This change recognizes one reviewed call in `PluginGateway.dispatch`. It checks the registered owner, both exact source files and modes, and the call's AST. The existing SQL and connection-authority checks still handle other calls and any drift in the binding. The producer changes the scanner and its tests. The accepted T2 source inventory, envelope, policy and registry carry forward.

The original domain suite and the seven new controls run in isolated discovery. The source-absent producer retains the dormant T2 baseline. Prospective validation of the unchanged private consumer exercises the new trusted classifier against the actual selected successor policy. The exact producer requires complete local verification and applicable normal CI, followed by the affected checks on actual Main.

Refs #1113, #767, #758 and #1110.
1114.head: codex/ar03-reviewed-tool-dispatch
1114.title: fix(architecture): recognize reviewed A32 dispatch in Store scan

1115.author: BESTTOOLBOX
1115.body:
PERM cannot currently expose its controlled Files read to the original App task, and TIMEOUT/SILENCE have no task-scoped model fault control in HK. This adds private test interfaces for those three existing cases. It adds no business case definitions and records no new device PASS.

| Existing case | Interface supplied |
| --- | --- |
| PERM-01 | A temporary Files capability for the three exact native requests. Each read checks the real Files grant; revocation returns the owner's denial. |
| TIMEOUT-01 | One bounded first-chunk timeout in the actual primary model stream, correlated with the original task, submission and model call. Native retry consumes no second fault. |
| SILENCE-01 | Pause after real text chunks, then resume or terminate that same model stream with applied receipts. |

Controls are disabled unless `DIGITALMATE_NIGHTLY_TEST_CONTROL_DIR` is configured. Private owner-only Unix sockets provide arm, inspect and cleanup operations. Leases bind account, room and exact objective; the Bridge supplies the actual task and runtime session. Expiry and teardown release waits and temporary credentials. No public control route, global model setting, permission bypass or App change is introduced.

The PERM sample is registered without automatic attachment to later messages, so the revoked request reaches the same actual read operation. Ordinary Files registration still defaults to retention. The default owned launcher and the existing Hosted factory binding remain distinct; test credentials are reconciled per runtime session without replacing a Hosted handle.

**Validation:** 14 focused interface tests passed: six Files scope/native submission/MCP checks, five actual `Model.stream` checks, and three private-socket/lease checks. The affected existing regressions also passed: 47 WorkSwarm adapter tests and 24 runtime factory tests. Python 3.12.13 used the candidate Bridge, WorkSwarm and Core source paths with the existing installed dependencies. Provider/Gateway responses are controlled substitutes; the Files owner, Bridge WebSocket, MCP stdio and model lifecycle are real local participants. These results do not establish HK or phone acceptance.

Reproduction commands and setup: [control guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/32ab114506da9a9c19a2f3fb4a2ebea13f97b6b2/docs/developer_guide/nightly-test-controls.md). Focused evidence is executable in:

- [test_nightly_files_test_scope.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/32ab114506da9a9c19a2f3fb4a2ebea13f97b6b2/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_nightly_files_test_scope.py)
- [test_nightly_files_test_wire.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/32ab114506da9a9c19a2f3fb4a2ebea13f97b6b2/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_nightly_files_test_wire.py)
- [test_e5_model_fault.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/32ab114506da9a9c19a2f3fb4a2ebea13f97b6b2/harness/tests/test_e5_model_fault.py)
- [test_nightly_test_controls.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/32ab114506da9a9c19a2f3fb4a2ebea13f97b6b2/tests/server/test_nightly_test_controls.py)

Harness source verification and manifest validation pass. A component-only diagnostic reports zero findings across 49 checked files. **The full architecture gate is blocked**: main `a2d64ea11191979e677c5b36836bd75217e6b14a` has an active T2 frozen registration and rejects the ownership-manifest change with `joint baseline policy changed; terminal withdrawal required`. This draft does not change the checker, registration, exceptions or CI thresholds. That integration constraint must be resolved through the owning registration workflow before merge. HK deployment and device execution remain pending.

Source: main `a2d64ea11191979e677c5b36836bd75217e6b14a`; interface head `32ab114506da9a9c19a2f3fb4a2ebea13f97b6b2`. Runtime and Files controls stay with the existing Runtime, Harness-adapter and Plugin owners, registered as checked modules. Store/schema ownership and ordinary product assertions are unchanged.

Related to #565. No case completion count is increased by these interface checks.

1115.title: test(nightly): add scoped Files and model fault interfaces
